Name: Coffee L’Orange – Cold Brew Kombucha (Set of 3 Bottles)
Tasting_Notes: Inspired by the iconic Coffee L’Orange served at ARAKU cafés, Coffee Kombucha brings together ARAKU’s Micro Climate
Desc: Inspired by the iconic Coffee L’Orange served at ARAKU cafés, Coffee Kombucha brings together ARAKU’s Micro Climate Arabica cold brew, artisanal kombucha, and vibrant citrus notes for the ultimate summer refresher. Crafted in collaboration with Dad’s Hack, a Bengaluru-based kombucha brewery, this sparkling brew is light, layered, and deeply refreshing — balancing the richness of cold brew coffee with the gentle tang of naturally fermented kombucha. Low in sugar, preservative-free, and naturally rich in probiotics and vitamins, it’s designed to energise while being easy on the gut. INGREDIENTS: Organic Kombucha Tea (64.10%) ARAKU Cold Brew Coffee (32.05%) 100% Natural Orange Syrup (3.85%) As kombucha is a living fermented beverage, suspended culture strands may naturally occur as a result of fermentation. FLAVOUR PROFILE: Bright citrus • Roasted coffee depth • Gentle fermented tang NOTE: Please note that all Coffee Kombucha orders will be shipped directly by Dad’s Hack.

Name: SOFI by Aaramse
Desc: SOFI is among the most versatile brewers you’ll ever use. From a concentrated, espresso-like cup to a clean, paper-filtered pour-over, it adapts effortlessly to every brewing style. Inspired by the iconic South Indian Filter, SOFI elevates tradition with a contemporary design — precision-cut filter holes, airflow vents that prevent stalling, and uncompromising build quality. No longer limited to Kaapi alone, SOFI’s standardised size and shape make it compatible with industry-leading paper filters like Kalita 185, AeroPress XL, and Sibarist DISC 72. This opens up a world of shared recipes and experimentation.

Name: High Altitude
Tasting_Notes: In Araku Valley’s Bakuru village
Desc: In Araku Valley’s Bakuru village, farmers Korra Chittibabu and Varalakshmi tend their coffee at elevations of 3,790 to 4,362 feet. Cool air, dark rocky soil, and a canopy of wild mango, jackfruit, and silver oak trees imbue this coffee with a quiet complexity. At this elevation, the coffee cherries ripen gradually, allowing sugars to concentrate and aromatic complexity to develop. The cherries are processed using the specialized black honey drying method, which preserves the natural sweetness of the bean, lending this coffee its rounded body and distinctive fruitiness. A medium roast coaxes out the full personality of the beans. The flavor opens with a gentle sweetness reminiscent of rose apple and buttercream cookies and is balanced by notes of caramel and baker's chocolate. Best enjoyed through slow brewing methods like pour-over or French press.

Name: Micro Climate Cold Brew Can
Desc: ARAKU's Micro Climate Cold Brew, now in a can—fruity, smooth, and built for an Indian summer. Sourced from the riverine island of Baankubedda in Araku valley, ARAKU Micro Climate coffee is cultivated by a small community of farmers across gently sloping, diversely shaded microplots. Surrounded by water and shaped by steady winds, these farms are defined by rich biodiversity and mineral-dense soil. Steeped for 16 hours, the flavour of this cold brew opens with notes of dried cherry, fig, and plum. Smooth and full-bodied, with a hint of natural sweetness, this cold brew is as refreshing as it is complex.

Name: AeroPress Coffee Maker with Selection
Tasting_Notes: dark chocolate and caramel, balanced by the mellow sweetness of sugarcane and honey, it is a coffee with a depth and ric
Desc: The AeroPress Coffee Maker Set with Selection Coffee is designed to make great coffee simple, bringing together one of the world's most beloved brewers with ARAKU's full-bodied Selection Coffee. Ideal for everyday use and thoughtful gifting, this set gives you everything you need to brew café-quality coffee at home. The AeroPress Coffee Maker is designed to bring out depth and clarity in your coffee. Using air pressure and micro-filtration, it extracts a clean, smooth cup in under two minutes. Simply add coffee, pour hot water, stir, and press. The AeroPress’ ability to extract bold flavours is what makes it especially well suited to ARAKU Selection coffee. Named for the carefully chosen plots from which it is sourced, Selection is grown in dark, rocky soil under a canopy of fruit trees. With notes of dark chocolate and caramel, balanced by the mellow sweetness of sugarcane and honey, it is a coffee with a depth and richness that the AeroPress brings to life. This set includes the AeroPress Coffee Maker and 500g of ARAKU Selection Coffee. Your coffee will be finely ground by default for best results with the AeroPress Coffee Maker. To request a different grind size, add a note at checkout.

Name: Hario V60 Arm Stand Glass Dripper Set
Desc: An elegant and one-stop solution to your V60 brewing needs - this set by HARIO includes the V60 Dripper, Caraffe, Arm Stand, Drip Tray, Filter Papers, and a Measuring Spoon.

Name: Brewista X Series Glass Server (400ML)
Desc: Inspired by wine decanters, the Brewista X Series Glass Server applies to coffee what the wine world has long known: how a drink is aerated shapes how it tastes. The server’s distinctive polygonal shape isn't just striking to look at, but also promotes even oxygenation as coffee flows in, bringing balance and depth without any need to swirl. The wide base traps aroma and holds heat, while the thick-rimmed, precision-curved spout gives you clean, controlled pours from the first cup to the last. Made from heat-resistant borosilicate glass and fitted with a sealed lid, the server keeps your coffee warm until you are ready to pour.

Name: Fellow Stagg EKG PRO Electric Kettle – 0.9L
Desc: The Fellow Stagg EKG Pro is a precision pour-over electric kettle built for coffee enthusiasts who want to fine-tune every aspect of their brew. Its variable temperature control allows adjustment to the degree, while the gooseneck spout delivers consistent, precise flow so every cup comes out just right. What sets the Pro apart is how seamlessly it fits into your morning routine. With its programmable features, you can schedule your kettle to heat automatically when you wake up and maintain your ideal temperature until you are ready to pour.

Name: CAFEC Flower Dripper DEEP 27
Desc: The CAFEC Flower Dripper DEEP 27 is designed for those ready to move beyond basic brewing — without overcomplicating the process. Its deeper 27° structure naturally slows down the flow of water, giving the coffee more time to extract evenly. This means you don’t need perfect technique to achieve a better cup. What you get instead is a brew that feels smoother, more balanced, and noticeably more refined. Inside, the signature flower-shaped ribs create subtle air channels that maintain a steady flow throughout the brew. This prevents clogging and ensures consistency, making it easier to get great results every time. Whether you’re upgrading from simpler brewing methods or refining your daily ritual, the DEEP 27 offers an approachable way to experience specialty coffee at home — with more control, more clarity, and more consistency. It pairs especially well with medium roast Arabica coffees, where notes of cocoa, roasted nuts, and gentle fruit sweetness come through with clarity and depth — without becoming too sharp or too heavy. Finished in a clear brown tone, it reflects a quiet, understated aesthetic — a brewing tool that feels as considered as the coffee you make with it.

Name: ORIGAMI Sensory Flavour Cup
Tasting_Notes: This allows flavours to feel clearer, more structured, and easier to recognise — from delicate florals to deeper cocoa
Desc: The ORIGAMI Sensory Flavour Cup is designed to enhance how coffee is experienced — not by changing the brew, but by refining how it is perceived. Its carefully considered form brings aromas forward and directs the flow of coffee across the palate in a more balanced way. This allows flavours to feel clearer, more structured, and easier to recognise — from delicate florals to deeper cocoa and caramel notes. What might feel subtle at first becomes unmistakable over time. A cup that feels more expressive. More complete. For those exploring specialty coffee, it offers a simple way to improve taste without changing how you brew. For those already familiar, it reveals greater clarity and nuance in every cup. Minimal in design and thoughtful in function, it becomes part of a quieter, more intentional coffee ritual — where even the cup contributes to the experience.

Name: Pocket Brew – Collection
Desc: From soil to cup, ARAKU is defined by its terroir—the unique combination of soil, climate, and altitude that gives our coffees their distinct character. With the Pocket Brew Collection , we’ve captured that story in elegant, single-serve drip bags you can brew anywhere. No grinder, no scale, no complicated equipment—just pure specialty coffee, simplified. Inside each box, you’ll experience three of ARAKU’s celebrated terroir coffees: Selection – smooth and balanced, perfect for everyday moments Micro Climate – nuanced layers that reflect the diversity of our valley Grand Reserve – rich, indulgent, and crafted for special occasions Whether you’re discovering specialty coffee for the first time or you’re a seasoned enthusiast seeking a travel-friendly solution, the Pocket Brew Collection makes it effortless to taste, compare, and choose your favorite ARAKU cup. Each drip bag is designed for consistency, freshness, and convenience—so you can enjoy café-quality coffee in just a few minutes. More than just a coffee kit, this collection is also a thoughtful gift. Presented in a beautifully designed, premium box, it’s perfect for colleagues, friends, and loved ones who appreciate craft, sustainability, and the joy of sharing great coffee. What’s Inside: This pack contains 15 single-serve coffee sachets — 5 each of Micro Climate , Selection , and Grand Reserve .

Name: Pocket Brew - Micro Climate
Desc: Our single-serve coffee packs combine the speed of an instant brew with the unrivalled quality of ARAKU's specialty coffee. As the name suggests, these drip bag sachets fit any pocket or purse and offer an extremely portable coffee. Each sachet is packaged individually and nitrogen-flushed to maintain the coffee's integrity and freshness. Suited for the airplane, the open road, hotels, offices, or even when you just need a quick fix at home. A sturdy cup and hot water does the trick. This pack contains 10 individual sachets.

Name: Grand Reserve
Desc: Sourced from the highest and most select plots—the Grand Cru—of Araku Valley, ARAKU Grand Reserve coffee is cultivated at high elevation by farmers Badnaini Sombabu and Subadramma. Grown in dark, rocky soil under a canopy of silver oak, mango, jackfruit, and jamun trees, this coffee reflects both the diversity of its terrain and the care with which it is grown. The flavour opens with notes of tropical fruit and citrus, followed by delicate florals and deeper notes of dates and olives, creating a cup that is both vibrant and well-rounded. Enjoy this brew black or with a splash of milk. Not sure which grind to order? Check out our grind size chart below for a quick brew tip!

Name: Christmas Gift Box (Bengaluru Exclusive)
Tasting_Notes: berries, jasmine, fruit candy, pomelo, and fennel seeds—aromatic, vibrant, and gently layered
Desc: This thoughtfully curated winter box brings together two comforting rituals. Our Winter Festive Edit coffee is a light, expressive cup with notes of berries, jasmine, fruit candy, pomelo, and fennel seeds—aromatic, vibrant, and gently layered. Clean acidity and floral sweetness make it ideal for slow, mindful brewing. Paired with it is our house-made granola, a wholesome blend of roasted almonds, cashews, raisins, and seeds, lightly bound with honey and lifted with hints of paprika and black pepper from the Araku Valley for a subtle, warming spice. Grown in the cool, high-altitude farms of Gondivalasa village (1083m), this coffee is nurtured by smallholder farming families practising regenerative agriculture. This Christmas edition carries a special story—Farmer Vanthala Lingo, who hums softly while handpicking cherries, recorded a 1.5× increase in Grade 1 cherries this season, reflecting seven years of committed regenerative farming. The result is a vibrant light roast that mirrors the brightness of the festive season—perfect for gifting, sharing, or elevating quiet winter mornings with warmth and intention. Kindly note: This product is available only for Bengaluru pincodes. Orders will be shipped starting 19th December 2025.

Desc: A coffee with glorious floral undertones from Gummaguda, with a cupping score of 86. Name: Festive Edit
Desc: Bright, expressive, and crafted for the season — ARAKU Coffee’s limited-edition Festive Edit is our celebratory release for the holidays. Grown in the cool, high-altitude farms of Gondivalasa village (1083m), this coffee is nurtured by skilled smallholder farming families whose regenerative methods preserve both the land and its legacy. This year’s Christmas edition stands out not only for its flavour but for the story behind its harvest. Farmer Vanthala Lingo, known for humming gentle melodies as she handpicks coffee cherries, recorded a remarkable 1.5 times increase in Grade 1 cherries this season — a testament to seven years of continuous regenerative farming. For her and her husband Shiva, abundance is not measured in quantity alone, but in the brighter future they are building for their children and their home. Their dedication is woven into every bean of this celebratory lot. The result is a light-roast profile that is both vibrant and elegant — perfect for discerning palates and festive gifting. Expect sparkling flavours that mirror the joyful brightness of the season. Whether you’re gifting loved ones, delighting clients, hosting festive gatherings, or simply elevating your own holiday rituals, this edition is a collectible coffee that captures the warmth, generosity of Christmas.

Name: NANOLOT : Cocoa Nibs & Spices, Washed Process
Desc: NANOLOT #5 is an 88-point washed coffee, released in just 84 packs of 250 g each, making it one of the most limited coffees in the NANOLOT Series. Grown at 1,149 metres above sea level in Kudasingi village, Pedabayalu Mandal, this lot was roasted in small batches to highlight clarity, sweetness, and balance. In the cup, NANOLOT #5 offers a sweet-spicy profile with depth and structure. It opens with notes of cocoa nibs and malt, followed by a gentle lemony brightness. As the cup cools, layers of sugarcane, honey, raisin, vanilla, and soft apricot begin to emerge, supported by delicate floral undertones. The body is syrupy and rounded, finishing clean and lingering—complex yet highly approachable. This coffee is washed and medium-light roasted, using a quick roast profile with approximately 12% development time ratio (DTR) and high airflow. This approach preserves freshness and aromatics while allowing sweetness and body to develop naturally. With a moisture content of 10.20% and a carefully controlled 4-day drying period, the green coffee showed excellent stability and clarity during roasting. The coffee is grown on dark brown, rocky soil with a natural medium slope, under a diversified shade canopy of over eight native and fruit tree varieties. These growing conditions slow cherry maturation, contributing to the coffee’s layered sweetness, refined acidity, and balanced structure.

Name: Taste the Terroir: Coffee Sampler Pack
Tasting_Notes: In specialty coffee, flavour begins long before
Desc: In specialty coffee, flavour begins long before roasting — it begins in the land. This Terroir Coffee Sample Pack is an invitation to explore how altitude, soil, micro-climate, and careful cultivation shape what you taste in the cup. Each coffee in this set comes from a distinct growing environment, allowing you to experience how terroir expresses itself through sweetness, acidity, body, and aroma. Curated for both discovery and comparison, this set lets you brew the coffees side by side, slow down, and understand your own preferences — before choosing a larger pouch. The collection includes four 100% Arabica coffees: Selection – Medium Dark Roast Rounded and balanced, with deeper body and comforting sweetness Signature – Medium Roast Smooth and versatile, designed for everyday clarity and balance Grand Reserve – Medium Roast Layered and refined, highlighting complexity and structure Micro Climate – Medium Roast Nuanced and expressive, shaped by specific micro-regional conditions Roasted to highlight origin character rather than bitterness, each coffee reflects ARAKU’s commitment to traceability, craft, and flavour clarity. Ideal for mindful brewing, thoughtful gifting, or anyone looking to deepen their understanding of specialty coffee — one cup at a time.

Name: Barista Skills: Professional
Desc: You must have completed the SCA Barista Intermediate Course to enroll in this course, and have experience as a working barista. On this three-day course you will be taught the cutting-edge concepts and techniques of the best Specialty Coffee Baristas, making this course essential for Baristas, trainers and dedicated coffee professionals. We will explore, design and evaluate brew recipes that are specific to the coffee, machinery and environment that you work in. We go in-depth into espresso extraction. We will analyze café design, workflow layout and financial management. The academy is equipped with top-of-the-line tools and an in-house roastery. ⁠The Coffee Skills Program at AWSCA consists of three different modules: Introduction to Coffee for beginners and coffee-enthusiasts, and specialised courses such as Barista Skills and Sensory Skills in different levels. Name: Coffee Masterclass: Barista Bootcamp: Coffee Crash Course
Desc: Ready to kickstart your career in the coffee industry? Our Barista Bootcamp is designed for aspiring baristas and future café owners who want to master the skills needed to thrive in a professional coffee environment. This intensive, hands-on 30-day course covers everything from the origins of coffee to the technical expertise required to create perfect espresso-based drinks. Gain real-world experience and essential skills to kickstart your coffee career with expert guidance by SCA-certified instructors and WBC standard training. Here’s what you can expect: • Coffee 360 ° ; dive deep into the "Seed-to-Cup" journey, understanding how factors like soil, terroir, processing and roast profiles affect the final flavour in your cup. • Espresso Brewing ; gain practical experience with commercial-grade espresso machines, mastering the nuances of shot pulling, grind size optimisation and milk frothing. • Brewing Techniques ; explore manual brewing methods, grinder calibration and brewing ratios to ensure consistency. • Latte Art & Milk Science; learn the essential techniques of milk steaming, understand the basics of latte art and how to neatly position your designs. • Real-World Café Training ; get hands-on experience at ARAKU cafés (Bangalore & Mumbai) applying your skills in a live café setting and learning the ropes of café operations. • Career-Ready Certification; at the end, you’ll graduate with an honorary AWSCA certificate and be fully equipped to apply for barista positions or take the next step towards opening your own café. Designed for small groups of five to ensure personalised learning, the Barista Bootcamp is perfect for anyone serious about pursuing a career in coffee or starting their own café. Join us and brew like a pro!

Name: Origami Dripper
Desc: The bright coloring and vertical grooves of this ORIGAMI dripper make it look like a folded ORIGAMI. Distinctive Vertical Ribs for Balanced Extraction The hallmark of the ORIGAMI dripper is its 20 precisely engineered vertical ribs. These ribs create a narrow air channel between the dripper and paper filter, regulating the flow of hot water. The result? A smooth, consistent pour that unlocks ideal extraction potential—just the way baristas envision. Dual Filter Compatibility: Conical & Wave ORIGAMI drippers are uniquely versatile, compatible with both conical and wave-style paper filters: Wave filters feature a thinner bed of coffee grounds, allowing water to pass through quickly for a more even, stable extraction. Conical filters , with a thicker powder layer, create richer extraction contrasts between the upper and lower layers. Brew the same coffee with each filter and taste the difference—explore flavor profiles tailored to your preference. High-Quality Ceramic Construction for Exceptional Brew Crafted from premium porcelain, the ORIGAMI dripper excels in heat retention and thermal conductivity. This ensures your brew stays at the ideal temperature throughout extraction, delivering a consistently delicious cup of coffee. Experience precision brewing with the ORIGAMI Dripper—engineered for flavor, designed for versatility. The colour of the product may vary. The images are for representative purposes only.

Sumanth is also an Authorised SCA Trainer (AST) and offers the highest quality of instruction for beginning baristas, roasters, and the serious and curious coffee connoisseur. All the courses are hosted at Araku World Specialty Coffee Academy (AWSCA), located at our flagship in Bangalore, Indiranagar. The academy is equipped with top-of-the-line tools and an in-house roastery. ⁠The Coffee Skills Program at AWSCA consists of three different modules: Introduction to Coffee for beginners and coffee-enthusiasts, and specialised courses such as Barista Skills and Sensory Skills in different levels. The courses range from 1-5 days with an opportunity for practical and written online exams to receive SCA certification. Instructions Please reach the venue 15 minutes prior to the event for registering, additional information etc. from your authorised trainer. Name: AeroPress Coffee Maker
Tasting_Notes: With ARAKU Coffee beans, it helps reveal layered notes with precision — fruit, florals, chocolate and sweetness
Desc: The AeroPress offers a remarkably elegant way to brew exceptional coffee at home. Compact in form yet impressive in performance, it uses gentle air pressure to create a cup that is smooth, clean and beautifully balanced. For those new to specialty coffee, it is one of the most effortless ways to begin — intuitive to use, quick in preparation and consistently rewarding in the cup. Simply add coffee, pour hot water, stir briefly and press. In under a minute, the AeroPress delivers a refined brew with clarity, body and minimal bitterness. It can be enjoyed as a shorter, more concentrated cup or prepared as a longer coffee, offering flexibility without complication. Loved by specialty coffee enthusiasts around the world, the AeroPress is valued for the control it brings to brewing and the way it allows quality coffee to speak for itself. With ARAKU Coffee beans, it helps reveal layered notes with precision — fruit, florals, chocolate and sweetness, all with a clean finish. Lightweight, durable and easy to clean, it fits seamlessly into everyday life — whether on your kitchen counter, office desk or in your travel bag. For anyone seeking a brewer that is accessible yet deeply respected, practical yet elevated, the AeroPress is a worthy addition to the ritual of coffee. New to AeroPress brewing? Explore our step-by-step guide here .

Name: Pocket Brew - Grand Reserve
Desc: Our single-serve coffee packs combine the speed of an instant brew with the unrivalled quality of ARAKU's specialty coffee. As the name suggests, these drip bag sachets fit any pocket or purse and offer an extremely portable coffee. Each sachet is packaged individually and nitrogen-flushed to maintain the coffee's integrity and freshness. Suited for the airplane, the open road, hotels, offices, or even when you just need a quick fix at home. A sturdy cup and hot water does the trick. This pack contains 10 individual sachets.

Name: ARAKU x Fellow Carter Move Mug
Desc: ARAKU teams up with San Francisco design icon Fellow to bring you the Move Mug where style meets function. Featuring ARAKU's vibrant leaf motif, this sleek travel mug keeps your coffee hot for 12 hours or cold for 24. Made from durable 18/8 stainless steel with a BPA-free lid and 'true taste' ceramic coating, it ensures every sip stays pure. The snap-in splash guard and slim profile make it perfect for on-the-go sipping. With a 12 oz (350 ml) capacity, it fits most drippers but is not compatible with the AeroPress or Prismo attachment. Slim enough for car cup holders and dishwasher-safe, the Move Mug is a practical, beautifully designed addition to your coffee ritual.

Name: Paragon Espresso - set of four
Desc: Elevate your espresso experience with the Paragon Espresso set. Featuring a patented chilling rock, this innovative tool is crafted from food-grade stainless steel with a durable titanium coating. The spherical shape and large surface area ensure rapid and even chilling, while the high-density liquid gel core maintains colder temperatures for longer, freezing faster than traditional alternatives. Scientifically proven to capture and express up to 40% more aroma molecules, the Paragon Espresso enhances flavor preservation. The height-adjustable design accommodates various cups and coffee machines, and anti-slip grips ensure stability. The 30mm chilling rock, designed specifically for espresso, is smaller than the Paragon Filter rocks, with additional rocks available for order. Specifications: Espresso Mount: (W) 34mm x (L) 120mm, Electrophoresis powder-coated Aluminium Chilling Rock: (Diameter) 30mm, SUS304 Stainless Steel with Titanium Coating, liquid core of glycerin and water Mount Grips: Silicone All materials are food-safe, FDA approved, and waterproof.

Perfect for V60, Kalita, and other pour-over drippers, this coffee carafe allows you to brew directly into the server and pour effortlessly into your cup. Whether you're brewing for yourself or sharing with guests, the Timemore coffee carafe offers the perfect balance of function, durability, and minimalist design.

Name: Kalita Wave Coffee Dripper 185
Desc: Enjoy café-quality coffee at home with the Kalita Wave 185 Pour-Over Dripper. Designed with a flat-bottom and three-hole system for a smooth, consistent extraction—every single brew. Its flat-bottom design and triple-hole drainage system work together to ensure a balanced, even extraction, making it the go-to dripper for both beginners and seasoned coffee lovers. Unlike cone-shaped brewers, the Kalita Wave creates a stable brewing environment. The Wave filter design minimizes contact between the filter and dripper, leading to smoother flavor and greater consistency in every cup. Crafted from heat-resistant glass or durable stainless steel , this dripper is designed for both form and function. Name: Chemex Coffee Maker
Desc: Chemex Classic Coffeemaker Elevate your morning ritual with the Chemex Classic Coffeemaker, the gold standard in manual pour-over brewing. Invented in 1941 by Dr. Peter Schlumbohm, this iconic vessel is more than just a coffee maker; it is a piece of modern art held in the permanent collection of MOMA, designed to deliver the purest flavor experience possible. Unlike standard drip machines, the Chemex is engineered for precision slow brewing. Crafted from non-porous, heat-resistant borosilicate glass, it ensures that no chemical residues or flavors are absorbed into your brew. Unmatched Clarity When paired with proprietary bonded filters, the Chemex removes fats, oils, and bitterness, resulting in a remarkably clean, bright, and sediment-free cup. Timeless Design The elegant glass hourglass shape is fastened with a polished wood collar and leather tie, offering both thermal protection and a stunning aesthetic for your kitchen counter. Choose Your Size: 3-Cup vs. 6-Cup Note: Chemex measures a "cup" as 5 oz (approx. 147.86 ml) Variant Ideal Capacity Best For 3-Cup (CM-1C) ~470 ml The Solo Brewer. Perfect for one generous mug of coffee. Uses Chemex Half-Moon filters. 6-Cup (CM-6A) ~880 ml The Standard. Ideal for brewing 2–3 mugs to share. Uses Chemex Square or Circular filters. Specifications Material: High-quality Borosilicate Glass (odor and residue-free). Handle: Polished wood collar with leather tie. Compatibility: Gas and glass stovetop safe (at low heat) for reheating. Care: Dishwasher safe (glass only; remove wood collar before washing). Result: Highlights the aromatic notes and subtleties of specialty coffee.
